gherkin.scenario: Add a rule to a leave right
given: I am logged in as a user
when: I click the View button for the "test" right
I click the Add button in the Rules section
I fill in the Rule title field with "test"
then: The message "The vacation right has been modified" should appear on the screen

gherkin_acceptance_criteria: The message "The vacation right has been modified" should appear on the screen
